name: Back-Safe Full Body
author: seed
coachNote: Your starter block — a back-safe A/B/C full-body split. Warm up every session, keep the key movements (Face Pull, Bird-Dog) in, and log your weights so your coach can progress you.

warmup.name: Treadmill or Bike
warmup.detail: 5 min easy pace — get blood moving, light sweat

warmup.name: Hip Circle (each side)
warmup.detail: 10 reps/side — hands on hips, slow controlled circles

warmup.name: Cat-Cow
warmup.detail: 10 reps — on all fours, arch and round your back slowly

warmup.name: Glute Bridge
warmup.detail: 15 reps — lie on back, feet flat, drive hips up and squeeze

warmup.name: Thoracic Rotation
warmup.detail: 8 reps/side — seated or kneeling, rotate upper back only

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart (or arms only)
warmup.detail: 15 reps — arms at shoulder height, pull apart and squeeze shoulder blades

cooldown.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
cooldown.detail: 30 sec/side — kneeling lunge position, sink hips forward

cooldown.name: Hamstring Stretch
cooldown.detail: 30 sec/side — seated or standing, keep back flat

cooldown.name: Child's Pose
cooldown.detail: 45 sec — arms extended, let lower back decompress

cooldown.name: Thoracic Extension over Bench
cooldown.detail: 30 sec — sit on bench edge, clasp hands behind head, extend upper back over edge gently

cooldown.name: Deep Breathing
cooldown.detail: 1 min — diaphragmatic breaths, in through nose, out through mouth

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell at chest, sit back and down, chest tall. Back-safe squat pattern.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Press (flat bench)
exercises.notes: Start light, controlled. Lower slowly (2 sec down), press up.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Light weight, shoulder health. Slight bend in elbow, raise to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension (cable)
exercises.notes: Rope attachment, elbows stay in place, extend fully.

exercises.name: Face Pull (cable, rope)
exercises.notes: Set cable at upper chest/face height. Pull rope to forehead, flare elbows high. Crucial for posture & shoulder health.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.notes: On all fours — extend opposite arm and leg, hold 2 sec, return. No hip rotation. Core must stay braced.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Lie on back, arms up, knees at 90°. Lower one arm + opposite leg simultaneously, lower back stays FLAT on floor.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Forearms or hands. Squeeze glutes, don't let hips sag. Build duration over time.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (dumbbells)
exercises.notes: Hip hinge — NOT a regular deadlift. Soft bend in knees, push hips back, weights track down legs. Feel hamstrings stretch. Back stays flat.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Neutral grip, pull to lower chest. Squeeze shoulder blades together at end. Don't round forward on the return.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Wide overhand grip. Pull bar to upper chest, lean back slightly. Controlled on the way up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Elbows stay at sides. Full range of motion. No swinging.

exercises.name: Face Pull (cable, rope)
exercises.notes: Set cable at upper chest/face height. Pull rope to forehead, flare elbows high. Crucial for posture & shoulder health.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.notes: On all fours — extend opposite arm and leg, hold 2 sec, return. No hip rotation. Core must stay braced.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
exercises.notes: Back-safe ab work. One knee bent, hands under lower back to preserve its curve. Lift only head and shoulders slightly. Hold 10 sec each rep.

exercises.name: Leg Press (machine)
exercises.notes: Feet shoulder-width, mid-height on platform. Don't lock knees at top. No spinal compression — great alternative to squats.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Bench at 30–45°. Control the descent, press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Brace on bench with hand and knee. Pull elbow straight back and up. Back stays flat and parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: Low cable, rope attachment, face away. Hinge at hips and drive them forward to stand. Teaches safe hip hinge pattern.

exercises.name: Face Pull (cable, rope)
exercises.notes: Set cable at upper chest/face height. Pull rope to forehead, flare elbows high. Crucial for posture & shoulder health.

exercises.name: Bird-Dog
exercises.notes: On all fours — extend opposite arm and leg, hold 2 sec, return. No hip rotation. Core must stay braced.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (cable)
exercises.notes: Stand sideways to cable machine. Press cable straight out from chest, hold 2 sec, return. Anti-rotation core — excellent for disk recovery.
